note: Red team. Scripted by actors, fictional. Two medicines in one sentence: the second must not take the first one's dose or frequency.

segments.text: Your blood sugar is a little high, so we need to add something today.
Keep the aspirin at seventy-five milligrams once a day, and add metformin five hundred milligrams twice a day.
Please come back and see me in three months.
If you feel very dizzy, call the clinic straight away.
